Vocab: Each token ID and its bytes.
Grammar.from_json_schema: Parses a [JSON Schema](https://github.com/IsaacBreen/glrmask/blob/main/GUIDE.md#grammar-formats), given as JSON text or a dict.
Grammar.compile: Compiles the grammar into a constraint.
Module.precompile: Compiles what it can now, even with externs unbound. Further compilation must use the same `vocab`.
Module.compile: Finishes compiling the module into a constraint.
Module.load: May fail if saved by a different GLRMask version.
Constraint.mask_bit_len: The mask's length in bits (the largest token ID plus one).
Constraint.load: May fail if saved by a different GLRMask version. Fails if `vocab` differs from the one it was compiled with.
ConstraintState.mask: Packed uint32 words: token i is bit i % 32 of word i // 32.
ConstraintState.fill_mask: Like `mask()`, but writes the words into `bitmask`. May release the GIL.
ConstraintState.mask_bit_len: The mask's length in bits (the largest token ID plus one).
ConstraintState.commit_token: Advances the state by the token. If it isn't allowed, returns `False` and terminates the state.
ConstraintState.commit_bytes: Advances the state by the bytes. If they aren't allowed, returns `False` and terminates the state.
ConstraintState.forced_bytes: The bytes that must come next.
ConstraintState.is_accepting: Whether the output so far could end here.
ConstraintState.is_terminated: Whether nothing more can be committed.
MaskStrategy: Controls how the constraint is compiled.
Externs: A read-only mapping of extern names to `Extern`.
Extern: A named placeholder in a grammar.
